components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Makes a Resurrection Ring with 3 charges. Worn, it cancels the death of a human killed by something supernatural: full health, Regeneration II for 10 seconds, one charge.
Anyone can perform it. The ring is not bound: whoever wears it is protected.

It saves only a human: no vampire or werewolf faction, and no species but Potential or Hunter of the Five. A witch or a siphoner is not saved. Only from supernatural killers, and only while it has charges.
